name: Welcome Series Journey
description: 5-step onboarding journey triggered when a new subscriber opts in. Sends a welcome email immediately, then nurtures with a category-specific content series over 14 days before exiting to the main newsletter audience.

triggers.name: New Subscriber Entry
triggers.description: Fires when a contact is added to the WelcomeSubscribers Data Extension by the nightly SQL automation.

activities.name: Send Welcome Email – Day 0
activities.description: Immediate welcome email with onboarding checklist and 15% welcome offer code.

triggeredSend.preHeaderText: Your exclusive welcome offer + onboarding checklist inside

activities.name: Wait 3 Days
activities.description: Wait 3 days after the welcome email before sending the category intro.

activities.name: Engagement Split – Opened Welcome?
activities.description: Branch subscribers based on whether they opened the Day 0 welcome email.

activities.name: Send Category Intro Email – Day 3
activities.description: Sends a category-specific curated content email to subscribers who opened the welcome.

triggeredSend.preHeaderText: Curated just for you based on your interests

activities.name: Send Re-Open Nudge Email – Day 3
activities.description: Gentle re-send nudge for subscribers who did not open the welcome email. Uses a different subject line.

triggeredSend.emailSubject: Did you see this, %%=v(@firstName)=%%? Your 15% off is waiting
triggeredSend.preHeaderText: We saved your welcome offer — it expires in 27 days

activities.name: Wait 4 Days (Engaged Path)
activities.description: Wait 4 days before sending the social proof / best-seller email.

activities.name: Wait 4 Days (Nudge Path)
activities.description: Wait 4 days after nudge before sending the final offer reminder.

activities.name: Send Best Sellers Email – Day 7
activities.description: Best-seller / social proof email at the 7-day mark to all welcome series subscribers.

triggeredSend.emailSubject: %%=v(@firstName)=%%, see what everyone's loving right now 🔥
triggeredSend.preHeaderText: Your personalised top picks + trending this week

activities.name: Wait 7 Days Before Final Welcome Email
activities.description: Wait 7 more days before the final welcome series email at day 14.

activities.name: Send Final Welcome Series Email – Day 14
activities.description: Loyalty program invitation and offer expiry reminder at the end of the welcome series.

triggeredSend.emailSubject: Last chance %%=v(@firstName)=%% — your welcome offer expires in 48h ⏰
triggeredSend.preHeaderText: Plus: join our loyalty program and start earning points today

activities.name: Update Contact – Mark Welcome Series Complete
activities.description: Sets WelcomeSeriesComplete=Y on the contact record so they move to the main newsletter audience.

activities.name: Exit – Welcome Series Complete
activities.description: Contact exits the journey and is now eligible for standard newsletter and promotional sends.

goals.name: First Purchase Within 30 Days
goals.description: Subscriber makes their first purchase within 30 days of joining — the primary conversion goal of this journey.
